 SUNITA KUMARI PRASAD Wife of Dayanand Prasad @ Daya Nand

 Versus  The State of Bihar  ... ... Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Dharmendra Kumar Paswan, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Sanjay Kumar Singh, APP.
 ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN  ORAL ORDER 4 21-07-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. Petitioner apprehends her arrest in connection with Forbesganj P.S. Case No. 1040 of 2022,
registered for the offence punishable u/s 419, 420, 467, 468 and 120B/34 of the IPC, pending in the court of learned C.J.M., Araria.
3. After some arguments, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw this application.
5. Accordingly, this application is dismissed as withdrawn.

6. However, if petitioner surrenders before the learned Court below within six weeks from today and seeks regular bail, Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.19080 of 2023(4) dt.21-07-2023 the learned Court below shall pass order on the same day in accordance with law without being prejudiced by this order.
